newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SWEDBANK MAY ACQUIRE C.BANK'S STAKE IN HOIU.
newsitem.headline: SWEDBANK MAY ACQUIRE C.BANK'S STAKE IN HOIU.

text.p: Hoiupank said on Wednesday that Sweden's Swedbank may buy the Estonian central bank's stake in it.
Swedbank already has a 12.5 percent stake in Hoiupank, which will increase to 25 percent if it buys the central bank's stake, Hoiupank said in a statement.

"The management of Hoiupank has become aware that Swedbank may increase its stake in Hoiupank, possibly through a purchase of shares currently owned by the Estonian central bank," the bank said in a statement.

"The management of Hoiupank is unaware of the exact size of Swedbank's likely participation but, based on experience to date, the cooperation with Swedbank has not demonstrated significant synergies between the two banks," it added.

"The management of Hoiupank does not believe that an increase in Swedbank's shareholding to the status of strategic investor would be to the benefit of either Hoiupank or its other shareholders," it said.
Hoiupank PR department head Krist Liiva told Reuters that the council will ask the shareholders' extraordinary meeting on July 1 to discuss the share sell-off.
